setupChecks.hint: clone the Survey Sheet repo beside this one
copy the test data from the private project docs

pageChecks.why: Simple Calendar's window comes back on each page
pageChecks.pages: the Bridge's page, each hidden session, the browser pane

handoff.load: Load foundry-module-dev, foundry-test-process and the module's skill.

loadByPhase.design: Load only the module's skill; read the plan and the design doc. No Foundry skills, no `guide start`.
loadByPhase.build: Load foundry-module-dev and the module's skill; `guide start`. Load foundry-vtt-operator, foundry-bridge and foundry-test-process when the chat first touches the live server (the test build), not before.
loadByPhase.live: Load foundry-module-dev, foundry-vtt-operator, foundry-bridge, foundry-test-process and the module's skill.

finishList: project doc for this module (what changed, what was verified)
the module's skill card, if the skill text changed
claude/foundry-version-baseline.md if an installed version changed
